cards.quote: On 24 October 1975, Icelandic women did not go to their paid jobs nor did they do any housework or child-rearing at home.

cards.claim: The Women's Strike took place on 24 October 1975 in Iceland.
cards.quote: 1975 Icelandic women 's strike Women 's Day Off Date 24 October 1975 Location Iceland Caused by Gender pay gap , occupational sexism Goals To `` demonstrate the indispensable work of women for Iceland 's economy and society '' and `` protest wage discrepancy and unfair employment practices '' . Methods Women 's strike On 24 October 1975 , Icelandic women went on strike for the day to `` demonstrate the indispensable work of women for Iceland 's economy and society '' [ 1 ] and to `` protest wage discrepancy and unfair employment practices '' .

cards.claim: The Women's Strike in Spain took place on March 8, 2018.
cards.quote: 2018 Spanish women's strike On March 8, 2018, International Women's Day, Spanish women went on strike for the day to denounce sexual discrimination, domestic violence and the wage gap .
